## Logistic Regression

### Single variable model

Make a logistic regression model using your best predictor variable

#### Model

NOTE TO SELF: ADD IN CODE IN DATA SPLIT THAT MAKES THE RESPONSE VARIABLE A FACTOR
NOTE TO SELF: ASK WHETHER TO CREATE MODEL ON TRAINING DATA AND ACCURACY ON TESTING DATA

```{r}
#recipe
log_rec<-
  recipe(Democracy~ <BESTVAR> , data=FullData_2025)

#setting engine
logit_mod <-
  logistic_reg()|>
  set_engine("glm")|>
  set_mode("classification")

# workflow
glm_workflow <-
  workflow() |>
  add_recipe(log_rec)|>
  add_model(logit_mod)

# fitting model
dem_fit <-
  glm_workflow |>
  fit(data = FullData_2025)
```

#### Equation and Graph of model

*Equation:*

```{r}
# GRAPH
FullData_bin <- FullData_2025 |>
  mutate(bin_dem=if_else(Democracy=="Yes",1,0))

ggplot(FullData_bin, aes(x = <BESTVAR>, y = bin_dem)) + 
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.05), 
    alpha = 0.5
  ) + 
  geom_smooth(
    method = "glm", method.args = list(family = "binomial"), 
    color = "dodgerblue", lty = 2, se = FALSE
  ) + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0.5), linetype = 3) 

```


#### Model evaluation-p-values, accuracy, cv for overfitting, roc, auc

```{r}
# p-value
tidy(dem_fit) 

# Accuracy
test_results <- augment(dem_fit, new_data = FullData_2025) # adding original data

test_metric<-test_results|>
  accuracy(truth = Democracy, estimate = .pred_class)
test_metric

# CV for Overfitting
set.seed(1776)
folds <- vfold_cv(FullData_2025, v = 5) #this makes the folds
class_met=metric_set(accuracy)

glm_dem_cv <- 
  glm_workflow |> 
  fit_resamples(resamples = folds,
    metrics = class_met)

cv_metrics<-collect_metrics(glm_dem_cv)
cv_metrics

# ROC & AUC
autoplot(roc_curve(test_results, truth = Democracy, `.pred_No`)) # ROC Graph
roc_auc(test_results, truth = Democracy, `.pred_No`) # AUC 

```

### All variable model

#### Model

```{r}

  recipe(Democracy~., data=FullData_2025)

  logistic_reg()|>
  set_engine("glm")|>
  set_mode("classification")

# workflow
glm_workflow2 <-
  workflow() |>
  add_recipe(log_rec)|>
  add_model(logit_mod)

# fitting model
```
